channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brook Lopez | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brook Lopez from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Brook Lopez, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Jeff Teague:

“We won a chip, I didn't care. Bro, we had the worst after party ever. Our after party was trash. Bro, look, I had better times at Louisville. It was me, Brook Lopez. Hey, I know you're going to have PJ on the show one day. PJ, bro, we were in there looking at each other like. Listen, yeah, the budget was Giannis. (Every championship team I know, they get the jet). Well, not this one ... We didn't celebrate. I'm telling you, there wasn't anything going on.”

Jeff Teague on Brook Lopez, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jun 11, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Alperen Sengun on Brook Lopez
item.description:
“I mean, Brook Lopez is a really good player. A really good defensive player, you know? But, I mean, he’s a good shot blocker. I don’t think he’s as good one-on-one player [as me]. We have different physical body. Like, he’s so tall. He’s big. He can block all the shots. I know I can’t block all the shots. I know that. I don’t have long arms. I’m not [that] tall. I just need to be where I have to be and just stay vertical. To jump straight up and just make their job harder.”

Alperen Sengun on Brook Lopez, Mar 8, 2024. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Alperen Sengun on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Şengün told Yahoo Sports.

“You don’t want to lose your spot. But if [Lopez] was coming, I was ready for a fight.”

Alperen Sengun on Brook Lopez, Mar 8, 2024. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Damian Lillard, on playing in a two-man game with Brook Lopez in the clutch:

“I just feel like I can get it done at that time, whether I'm scoring or making the play or if I get fouled going to the free throw line, I think that's a great option for us.”

Damian Lillard on Brook Lopez, Nov 19, 2023. Source: Twitter @eric_nehm.

item.title: Grayson Allen on Brook Lopez, Serge Ibaka, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis
item.description:
“When a guy’s driving, you don’t want to over-help or shift all the way. You kind of trust that either the guy guarding the ball is going to guard his guy straight upor it’s going to be Brook (Lopez), Giannis (Antetokounmpo), Bobby (Portis), Serge (Ibaka), one of the bigger guys coming over. “And then the guards are more staying home and either trying to completely limit the pass or if they do get the pass off, just be there, so they can’t get the shot off. It’s slightly different with our habits off the ball, so it’s not a huge change.”

Grayson Allen on Brook Lopez, Serge Ibaka, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis, Oct 4, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Chris Bosh on Brook Lopez, DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Chris Bosh:

“Shoot it. That’s it. Shoot it. Shoot it. That’s all he needs to do is shoot it, I’m telling you. I did it for 13 years in the league, man, and it didn’t steer me wrong. Shoot it. He has the playmaking ability, he is unselfish. It’s wonderful that he’s a team player. But for him to get to where he wants to go, he’s going to have to shoot the ball. I think he’s more than capable. Once he proves that he’s a threat out there, Brook Lopez and DeAndre Jordan and all those bigs, they can’t just be in the middle of the paint playing traffic cop. He needs to come back and he needs to shoot it until they guard him. That would be my recommendation.”

Chris Bosh on Brook Lopez, DeAndre Jordan, Aug 30, 2021. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Kevin Chouinard:Nate McMillan on Brook Lopez:

“We have to move him around ... He does a good job of zoning up in the paint.”

Nate McMillan on Brook Lopez, Jun 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Derrick Favors on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Eric Walden:Derrick:

“I think I can improve [3-point shooting]. … That's something I do want to improve on. I'm not saying I'm going to be Brook Lopez out there.”

Derrick Favors on Brook Lopez, Apr 25, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Luke Walton on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Luke Walton on Brook Lopez injury:

“You feel for him. It’s always tough for players when they get hurt.”

Luke Walton on Brook Lopez, Dec 19, 2017. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Lonzo Ball on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Serena Winters:Lonzo Ball on Brook Lopez's return:

“He’s one of the best big men in the league…I’m excited to see what he's going to do out there.”

Lonzo Ball on Brook Lopez, Oct 7, 2017. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Jeremy Lin:

“I’m really satisfied (with the Nets offseason additions). Of course, I’ll miss Brook Lopez. We were good friends and we paired well together. They already traded him away, but I feel like we’ll be a stronger team this year.”

Jeremy Lin on Brook Lopez, Aug 1, 2017. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Kenny Atkinson on Brook Lopez:

“This doesnt mean he wont play back-2-backs the rest of the year... We take each portion of the schedule & look at it. We’re all on board with this. He’s on board, I’m on board, the performance team, everybody.”

Kenny Atkinson on Brook Lopez, Oct 29, 2016. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Sean Marks on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Andy Vasquez:Sean Marks:

“I talked to Brook [Lopez] today, I discussed things with him, and he's excited about the approach and where things are going.”

Sean Marks on Brook Lopez, Jun 24, 2016. Source: Twitter @andy_vasquez.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Brook Lopez
item.description:
“Nets coaches have had a love/hate relationship wih Brook Lopez. Some guys love him, some guys have wanted to trade him. Is he a building block player for this team?”

Kenny Atkinson on Brook Lopez, May 21, 2016. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Brett Yormark on Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Bojan Bogdanovic, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson
item.description:
“We’ve got a good story to tell -- with the addition of our $50 million practice facility and the D-League franchise -- and I think we’ll be in a position where we’ll be able to add to Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, Bojan Bogdanovic and some of the other younger pieces, and bring in the necessary pieces to turn things around quickly.”

Brett Yormark on Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Bojan Bogdanovic, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, Dec 19, 2015. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Mikhail Prokhorov on Brook Lopez:

“I think he is the best center in the league, and I hope he stays healthy. That’s it.”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Brook Lopez, Sep 30, 2015. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Billy King on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Rod Boone:Billy King on if he's received any indicators from Brook Lopez:

“Nah, not really. He’s been around. He’s been working out. So that’s always a plus.”

Billy King on Brook Lopez, Jun 22, 2015. Source: Twitter @rodboone.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Devin Kharpertian:Lionel Hollins on Brook Lopez's upcoming free agency:

“I want him to be here. I want him to be here. I want him to be here.”

Lionel Hollins on Brook Lopez, Mar 30, 2015. Source: Twitter @uuords.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Brook Lopez
item.description:
Royce Young:KD on Lopez rumors:

“He's not on our team now. I'm just focused on the guys in our locker room. I trust the front office is going to make the right moves for our franchise. I'm more concerned with the guys we have here.”

Kevin Durant on Brook Lopez, Jan 16, 2015. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.

item.title: Deron Williams on Brook Lopez
item.description:
“We do have to play better. We’re two of the highest paid players on the team [Williams is making $19.8 million this season, Lopez $15.7 million], so that’s our responsibility -- to play better. And then hopefully we can accept that challenge -- I know I do. I think Brook does -- and just move forward.”

Deron Williams on Brook Lopez, Dec 28, 2014. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Deron Williams on Brook Lopez
item.description:
“All it is is rumors and sources. Sources are not credible to me. Until you put a name to a source, it’s not credible. “I’d be really surprised if Lopez doesn’t make (the All-Star reserves, which will be announced tomorrow). I don’t know how you could leave Brook off. What he’s meant to this team on both sides of the floor. He’s been the most consistent throughout this season. I think he’s an All-Star. …I think in general he just came in with a chip on his shoulders, being in thrown around in trade rumors for the last two years and being hurt last year and people doubting him, so I think he definitely came in ready to go this year and really confident. Hopefully people are taking notice.”

Deron Williams on Brook Lopez, Jan 23, 2013. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Avery Johnson on Brook Lopez
item.description:
“Right now, we’re trying to get Brook Lopez re-signed and get him back in a Nets uniform. We can’t control what other teams are doing. When you’re talking about trading with another team we have no power. Like every NBA team, you make proposals and presentations but at the end of the day you have no control. The only thing we have control of right is getting our guys re-signed, getting Brook Lopez re-signed, figuring out what we’re going to do with a couple of other situations, but that’s what Billy’s main focus is right now -- is getting Brook re-signed and getting him in a Nets uniform.”

Avery Johnson on Brook Lopez, Jul 8, 2012. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Billy King on Brook Lopez
item.description:
King told reporters in Miami on Tuesday.

“We’ve got a young player, 23, and we’re going to make a decision, ‘Do we keep him out the rest of the year?’ Because I think it’s important for us to have a healthy Brook Lopez. And he’s not going to be out for the rest of the year, but at three weeks, if he still has a little soreness in the ankle, we’re going to hold him out. We want him as healthy as possible.”

Billy King on Brook Lopez, Mar 7, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.
